inputs.name: ManageController.constructor.scope
inputs.description: A HostScope dependency used only by register. After validating the body, the controller calls owns(input.hostId) and returns 400 invalid-input if it returns false.

inputs.name: ManageController.constructor.store
inputs.description: A HostStorageAdapter used by summary, revoke-device, and unregister. The controller calls host() and returns 404 not-found when the record is absent or its hostId differs from the validated call.

inputs.name: ManageController.constructor.registry
inputs.description: A HostRegistryService used for registration, summary, and unregistration. register(input) produces a 200 response when truthy and a 403 forbidden response otherwise; summary(host) supplies the summary response, and unregister() is awaited before a 200 response.

inputs.name: ManageController.handle.request
inputs.description: A Fetch API Request passed to handle. It must use POST and name a supported operation for body parsing to occur; other methods or operation names return 404 not-found before parsing.

inputs.name: ManageController.handle.operation
inputs.description: The management route operation handled with the request. Accepted values are register, summary, revoke-device, and unregister; other values return 404 not-found before request-body parsing.

outputs.name: ManageController.handle
outputs.description: A promise resolving to the Fetch API Response returned by the controller. Responses use status 404 for non-POST or unsupported operations, 400 for invalid input, 403 for owner mismatch or failed registration, and 200 for successful operations; a missing or mismatched host also returns 404.
